objective: Direct and group chats support selecting a Google Maps place or current location, plus long-press reply, edit and delete.

location: Search or tap a map point, or explicitly request current location
Send once to the active conversation
message: Long press or accessible menu action
Edit own text without losing the existing draft
Show edited and deleted states to both participants

contracts.provider: Existing react-native-webview with Google Maps JavaScript and Places (New); API key not configured
contracts.send: Reuse existing guarded send functions atomically for new reply/location metadata
contracts.author_mutation: Server checks active account, conversation access, ownership, current message revision and active conversation
contracts.evidence: Keep earlier content in a private history with the existing audited AAL2 admin boundary
contracts.privacy: Reply joins obey message RLS; no live GPS permission until current-location selection
contracts.safety: Retained originals remain in the existing server-only safety RPC and review hash; no worker/model/service added.

commands: npx --no-install eslint src/components/chat-room.tsx src/components/chat-location-picker.tsx src/lib/chat-location.ts src/lib/community-data.ts
docker exec -i supabase_db_gling psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1
style: Reuse RoomAction, ThemedText, theme tokens and useInteractionFeedback; no new dependency or generic state abstraction.
testing: Real SQL transaction with rollback; component event tests, message bridge validation, map API mocks and 320/390/768/1440px interactive checks.
boundaries: No production migration or build upload
No new dependency, service or Google billing setup
Preserve moderation, reports, blocking, read history and double-tap reactions
Provider configuration remains separate from mock verification
